page.title: Hangout
page.description: Walk between rooms and chat with whoever is around, in the spirit of the old telnet talkers.

stage.label: The room and the people in it
stage.hint: Tap the floor to walk · tap someone for their card · arrow keys walk too
stage.hint_guest: You're looking in from outside. Log in to walk in and talk.

bar.label: Say something, or type a command
bar.guest: Log in to walk in and talk.
bar.cannot_talk: You can look around, but you can't talk here.

tabs.tells_empty: Pages and tells sent to you show up here. Try "tell name = hi".
tabs.chan_empty: Nothing said on this channel since you came in.

board.title: The notice board
board.no_notes: No notes on this board yet. Pin the first one!
board.subject: Subject

mail.hint: Mail waits for people who aren't here. Send it with mail name = message.

alerts.proposal: {name} has asked to be your partner. Type partner accept, or partner decline.

errors.generic: Something went wrong. Try again in a moment.
errors.permission_denied: You don't have permission to do that.
errors.slow_down: Slow down a little: you're talking faster than the room allows.
errors.moron_page: Morons can only page and tell staff (Apprentice Wizards and Druids and above).
errors.page_wait: Please wait {seconds, plural, one {# second} other {# seconds}} before sending them another message.
errors.nothing_to_reply: Nobody has paged or told you anything to reply to yet.
errors.no_exit: There's no way out called {name} here.
errors.no_such_mood: {name} isn't one of the feelings. Type feeling list to see them all.
errors.no_rooms: The Hangout has no rooms yet.
errors.shout_wait: You can shout again in {minutes, plural, one {# minute} other {# minutes}}.
errors.yell_wait: You can yell once a minute.
errors.which_channel: Which channel? Type -name message, for example -gaming hello.
errors.no_channels: You're not on any channel yet. Type channels to see them.
errors.no_friends_on: None of your friends are connected right now.
errors.blocked: They aren't taking messages from you.
errors.too_many: That's the most you can have ({max}).
errors.no_proposal: Nobody has asked to be your partner.
errors.already_partnered: You already have a partner. Type partner end first.
errors.bbs_incomplete: A note needs a subject and some words.
errors.muted: You've been muted. You can talk again in {minutes, plural, one {# minute} other {# minutes}}.
errors.outranked: You can only do that to people below your rank.
errors.no_such_message: That message isn't there any more.
errors.reports_off: Reporting needs the Flags extension, which this forum doesn't have turned on.

line.propose: {name} asks if you'll be their partner. Type partner accept, or partner decline.
line.propose_sent: You ask {to} to be your partner.
line.muted: {name} has muted you for {m, plural, one {# minute} other {# minutes}}. You can still look around and listen.
line.muted_sent: You muted {to} for {m, plural, one {# minute} other {# minutes}}.
line.unmuted: {name} has unmuted you. You can talk again.

out.unknown: Sorry, “{command}” isn't a command. Type help for a list.
out.reported: Thanks. The moderators have been told.
out.recall_title: The last pages and tells sent to you
out.recall_hint: Reply with reply = message, or page 2 = message to answer the second one.
out.recall_none: Nobody has paged or told you anything yet.
out.feelings_hint: Try wave, wave Ben, wave happily at Ben, or hug Ben = tightly.
out.reconnected: You were away a long time, so you've been connected again.
out.home_set: {room} is your home now: you'll connect here.
out.description_set: Your description is saved. Others see it when they look at you.
out.channels_hint: Talk on a channel with -name message (for example -gaming who's playing?). It follows you from room to room.
out.channel_join: You join #{name}. It has its own tab now.
out.friends_none: No friends yet. Add one with friend name.
out.friend_add: {name} is your friend now: you'll hear when they connect.
out.friend_remove: {name} isn't on your friends list any more.
out.enemy_add: You're ignoring {name}: their talk is hidden and their pages and tells won't reach you.
out.mail_sent: Mail sent to {name}. They'll get a notification.
out.aliases_none: No aliases yet. Make one with alias hi = say hello everyone!
out.partner_none: You haven't got a partner. Ask someone with partner name.
out.partner_proposed: You've asked {name}; they haven't answered yet.

help.title: Commands
help.tokens: Anything that isn't a command is said. Start with / to make it a command (/who, /wave ben). Shortcuts: :waves emotes, +hmm thinks, >ben hi tells, <ben waves remotes, !hi shouts, -gaming hi talks on a channel. Arrow keys walk; Enter jumps here.

what.say: Talk to the room. A speech bubble pops up over you.
what.emote: Do something: “:waves hello” shows “Ernest waves hello”.
what.feelings: Every feeling command: wave, hug, ack, aha, baa, moose…
what.page: A short message to people in any room.
what.tell: A private message to people in any room.
what.recall: The last eight pages and tells sent to you.
what.reply: Answer whoever last paged or told you.
what.who: Everyone connected, with titles, rooms and idle times.
what.look: The room, or a person's card.
what.go: Go through a door, by name.
what.home: Go home, or make this room your home.
what.afk: Mark yourself away. Doing anything brings you back.
what.title: The words after your name on the who list.
what.prefix: Words before or after your name.
what.describe: What people see when they look at you.
what.feeling: How you're feeling, on your card.
what.cmessage: What everyone sees when you connect or leave.
what.time: The time on the forum's clock.
what.shout: One line to every room. Mortals wait between shouts.
what.yell: Heard in every room of your area.
what.channel: Channels follow you between rooms, each with its own tab.
what.friend: Friends are pinged when they connect; enemies are ignored.
what.mail: A note for someone who isn't here; it arrives as a notification.
what.bbs: The notice board in the Lobby.
what.partner: TCZ's 'net' partners: ask, accept, or part.
what.report: Tell the moderators about a message. It raises a flag for them.
what.mute: Druids and up: stop someone talking for a while (10 minutes unless you say).
what.remove: Druids and up: take a message out of everyone's log.

settings.nav: Show Hangout in the forum's navigation
settings.ranks_help: TCZ's ranks. A member holds the highest rank of any group they're in; members in none are Mortals. Moron is the punishment rank and wins over every other. Apprentices and up shout without waiting and can page anyone; Morons can only page staff.
settings.say_per_minute_help: How many things a member can say, emote or page in a minute. Apprentices and up get three times as many.
settings.shout_minutes_help: How long a Mortal waits between shouts. Apprentices and up never wait. 0 means no wait.
settings.idle_minutes_help: When someone starts to doze on the who list and in the room.
settings.keep_days_help: Older room talk, pages and tells are forgotten.
settings.timezone_help: A time zone such as America/Chicago, for the sky and the time command. Empty uses the server's.

permissions.talk: Walk in and talk in the Hangout
